description: The plot illustrates the proportion of harmful responses where the model showed a rejection tendency, comparing four different models across varying input sizes. The x-axis is labeled with no specific title but represents input sizes, with a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, marked at intervals of 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. The plot includes four lines representing different models: LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue, circle markers, solid line), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (green, triangle markers, solid line), LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (orange, square markers, solid line), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red, diamond markers, solid line). The blue line starts at approximately 0.18 at x=128, increases to about 0.38 at x=512, and then levels off to around 0.39 at x=1024. The green line begins at roughly 0.2 at x=128, rises to approximately 0.4 at x=512, and remains steady at about 0.4 at x=1024. The orange line commences at around 0.28 at x=128, ascends to about 0.45 at x=512, and then plateaus at approximately 0.45 at x=1024. The red line starts at roughly 0.3 at x=128, climbs to about 0.46 at x=512, and continues to rise to approximately 0.52 at x=1024.
